sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一具女性遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到斩首，体内血液已被放干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她仅被称为“无名氏”。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但她的身份确认，反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是Casefile Presents推出的全新系列节目，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: Marilyn Moore ran away from home when she was 15 years old.
sentences.zh: 玛丽琳·摩尔在15岁时离家出走。

sentences.en: She married at 16, divorced at 19, and then started sex work.
sentences.zh: 她16岁结婚，19岁离婚，随后开始从事性工作。

sentences.en: She worked around London and Bradford before moving to Leeds.
sentences.zh: 她在搬到利兹之前，曾在伦敦和布拉德福德一带工作。

sentences.en: Marilyn lived in a town only about one mile away from the red light district of Chapel Town.
sentences.zh: 玛丽琳住的小镇距离查佩尔镇的红灯区仅约一英里。

sentences.en: At 8pm on Wednesday the 14th of December 1977, 25-year-old Marilyn was working in Chapel Town.
sentences.zh: 1977年12月14日星期三晚上8点，25岁的玛丽琳正在查佩尔镇工作。

sentences.en: She saw a man in a car circling the area.
sentences.zh: 她看到一辆车在附近盘旋。

sentences.en: In order to get noticed, Marilyn walked towards him.
sentences.zh: 为了引起注意，玛丽琳朝车走去。

sentences.en: As soon as she was in his line of sight, he got out of the car and started talking to it.
sentences.zh: 当她进入他的视线时，他下了车，开始和她搭话。

sentences.en: they agreed on the standard price of five pounds marilyn jumped into the front passenger seat of
sentences.zh: 他们谈妥了五英镑的标准价格，玛丽琳坐进了副驾驶座。

sentences.en: his car before the man got in she noticed him waving to someone on the street once inside the
sentences.zh: 在那人上车前，她注意到他向街上的某个人挥手，上车后，

sentences.en: man told marilyn he knew a quiet place he started to talk about himself he said his name was david
sentences.zh: 那人告诉玛丽琳他知道一个安静的地方。他开始谈论自己，说他叫大卫，

sentences.en: but that he preferred dave marilyn asked him who he was waving at before he got into the car and he said it was his girlfriend.
sentences.zh: 但他更喜欢别人叫他戴夫。玛丽琳问他在上车前向谁挥手，他说那是他女朋友。

sentences.en: Dave then told Marilyn about two sex workers from Chapeltown who he was good friends with, Gloria and Hilary.
sentences.zh: 戴夫随后向玛丽琳提起查佩尔镇的两名性工作者，说她们是他很好的朋友，分别是格洛丽亚和希拉里。

sentences.en: Marilyn had never met or heard of any women named Gloria or Hilary that worked in Chapeltown.
sentences.zh: 玛丽琳从未见过或听说过查佩尔镇有叫格洛丽亚或希拉里的女性。

sentences.en: They only drove about one and a half miles.
sentences.zh: 他们只开了大约一英里半的路程。

sentences.en: Dave stopped the car behind Brown's factory in Bustling Thorpe Lane.
sentences.zh: 戴夫把车停在巴斯林索普巷布朗工厂的后面。

sentences.en: It was an abandoned lot.
sentences.zh: 那是一片荒地。

sentences.en: Dave got out of the car and asked Marilyn to get in the back seat.
sentences.zh: 戴夫下了车，让玛丽琳坐到后座去。

sentences.en: Marilyn agreed and opened the front door and then walked to the rear door.
sentences.zh: 玛丽琳同意了，打开前门，然后走到后门。

sentences.en: As soon as Marilyn opened the rear door she was clubbed from behind.
sentences.zh: 玛丽琳刚打开后门，就被人从背后重击。

sentences.en: She immediately fell to the ground.
sentences.zh: 她立刻倒在地上。

sentences.en: Marilyn screamed and put her arms over her head to try and protect herself.
sentences.zh: 玛丽琳尖叫着，用双臂护住头部试图保护自己。

sentences.en: The attack continued until Marilyn was knocked unconscious.
sentences.zh: 袭击持续进行，直到玛丽琳被打昏过去。

sentences.en: A nearby a dog started barking at the commotion and it's thought this is what frightened the ripper off.
sentences.zh: 附近的一条狗被骚动惊动开始吠叫，人们认为正是这一点吓跑了“开膛手”。

sentences.en: He got back into his car and took off at high speed.
sentences.zh: 他回到车里，高速逃离了现场。

sentences.en: Marilyn came to and managed to stagger to
sentences.zh: 玛丽琳苏醒过来，设法蹒跚着走到

sentences.en: Scott Hall Road which was nearby.
sentences.zh: 附近的斯科特霍尔路。

sentences.en: She approached a young couple who were chatting there.
sentences.zh: 她走近一对正在那里聊天的小情侣。

sentences.en: Her head was bleeding badly and she asked them to call an ambulance.
sentences.zh: 她的头部血流不止，请求他们帮忙叫救护车。

sentences.en: Marilyn was rushed to hospital where she was seen by a neurological surgeon.
sentences.zh: 玛丽琳被紧急送往医院，由一名神经外科医生接诊。

sentences.en: The surgeon determined that Marilyn required immediate surgery.
sentences.zh: 医生判定玛丽琳需要立即手术。

sentences.en: Soon after being admitted to hospital, David Gee, the forensic pathologist who had been working on the Ripper case since the very beginning, attended to examine her.
sentences.zh: 入院后不久，从一开始就参与“开膛手”案件的法医病理学家大卫·吉赶来对她进行检查。

sentences.en: Marilyn had eight wounds on her head.
sentences.zh: 玛丽琳的头部有八处伤口。

sentences.en: One had sunk the skull into the brain so deeply that the neurosurgeon had to elevate the skull bone to relieve the pressure.
sentences.zh: 其中一处导致颅骨深深凹陷进大脑，神经外科医生不得不抬起颅骨以减轻压力。

sentences.en: All of the wounds were oval in shape and Gee believed they'd been caused by a hammer.
sentences.zh: 所有伤口呈椭圆形，吉认为它们是由锤子造成的。

sentences.en: The wounds were very similar to those found on the other Ripper victiMs. The next day, two officers went to the hospital to question Marilyn.
sentences.zh: 这些伤口与其他“开膛手”受害者的伤口非常相似。第二天，两名警官前往医院询问玛丽琳。

sentences.en: She was still recovering and in a very weak condition, but she was able to describe her attacker in astonishing detail.
sentences.zh: 她当时仍在恢复中，身体非常虚弱，但她还是能够极其详细地描述袭击者的特征。

sentences.en: He was a white male, late 20s, about 5 feet 6 inches tall, with a stocky build.
sentences.zh: 他是一名白人男性，20多岁，身高约5英尺6英寸，身材魁梧。

sentences.en: He had long, dark, curly hair, a short, full beard, and what Marilyn referred to as a Jason King moustache.
sentences.zh: 他留着长长的深色卷发，短而浓密的胡须，还有玛丽琳所说的“杰森·金”式胡子。

sentences.en: Jason King was a fictional character from a TV crime series that aired in the UK at the time.
sentences.zh: 杰森·金是当时英国热播的一部犯罪电视剧中的虚构角色。

sentences.en: He had a droopy looking full moustache that ran down past the mouth.
sentences.zh: 他留着一种下垂的浓密胡须，一直延伸到嘴巴下方。

sentences.en: Marilyn also said the Ripper had brown eyes, bushy eyebrows, and a suntanned complexion.
sentences.zh: 玛丽琳还说，“开膛手”长着棕色的眼睛，浓密的眉毛，肤色黝黑。

sentences.en: He was wearing a yellow shirt, blue jeans, and a dark coloured zip-up lightweight coat.
sentences.zh: 他穿着一件黄色衬衫、蓝色牛仔裤和一件深色的轻便拉链外套。

sentences.en: marilyn described him as being softly spoken furthermore she said he was good looking and
sentences.zh: 玛丽琳形容他说话轻声细语，此外，她说他长得很帅，

sentences.en: he seemed to know it he was driving a maroon or dark colored car detective jim hobson gave those
sentences.zh: 而且他似乎也知道这一点。他开着一辆栗色或深色的车。侦探吉姆·霍布森将这些

sentences.en: details to the press the jason king description along with a photo fit image of the suspect was
sentences.zh: 细节告知了媒体。杰森·金的描述连同嫌疑人的模拟画像被

sentences.en: highly publicized hobson also added that the ripper was well acquainted with the back streets of Chapeltown, given the route he took after picking Marilyn up.
sentences.zh: 大肆宣传。霍布森还补充说，“开膛手”对查佩尔镇的后街非常熟悉，从他接走玛丽琳后所走的路线就能看出来。

sentences.en: The Ripper had told Marilyn that his name was David, and the police believed this might actually be his real name.
sentences.zh: “开膛手”曾告诉玛丽琳他叫大卫，警方认为这可能确实是他的真名。

sentences.en: They went back through all of the index cards listing the details of people that had been checked out throughout the entire investigation.
sentences.zh: 他们翻阅了整个调查过程中所有被排查人员的索引卡片。

sentences.en: That was over 175,000 people at this point.
sentences.zh: 此时涉及的人数已超过175,000人。

sentences.en: They found 1,037 men named David that had come up in one way or another, and had already been interviewed and eliminated.
sentences.zh: 他们找到了1,037名以某种方式出现过、且已被讯问并排除嫌疑的大卫。

sentences.en: They were all interviewed again and asked to provide alibis for the night Marilyn was attacked.
sentences.zh: 他们被再次传唤，并被要求提供玛丽琳遇袭当晚的不在场证明。

sentences.en: Nothing further came out of these interviews.
sentences.zh: 这些讯问没有取得任何进展。

sentences.en: It was more than likely Dave wasn't the attacker's real name anyway.
sentences.zh: 而且，“戴夫”很可能根本不是袭击者的真名。

sentences.en: Sex workers were also questioned about Gloria and Hillary, who the Ripper had told Marilyn he was friends with, but they didn't seem to exist either.
sentences.zh: 警方还询问了性工作者关于格洛丽亚和希拉里的情况，但她们似乎也不存在。

sentences.en: So the police focused on the car.
sentences.zh: 于是警方将重点转向了那辆车。

sentences.en: Marilyn was able to provide a decent description, maroon or dark-coloured, four doors with two interior rear-view mirrors.
sentences.zh: 玛丽琳提供了一个不错的描述：栗色或深色，四门，车内有两个后视镜。

sentences.en: At the crime scene where Marilyn was attacked, police located tyre tracks, which they made plaster casts of.
sentences.zh: 在玛丽琳遇袭的犯罪现场，警方发现了轮胎痕迹，并制作了石膏模型。

sentences.en: The tyre tracks were very similar to those left at Irene Richardson's murder scene, and after further analysis and taking into account Marilyn's description,
sentences.zh: 这些轮胎痕迹与艾琳·理查森谋杀现场留下的痕迹非常相似，经过进一步分析并结合玛丽琳的描述，

sentences.en: police reduced the list of possible cars to eight.
sentences.zh: 警方将可能的车型范围缩小到了八种。

sentences.en: Five of those eight were different models of the
sentences.zh: 其中五种是不同型号的

sentences.en: BMC Farina.
sentences.zh: BMC法里纳。

sentences.en: Marilyn discharged herself from hospital 10 days after her attack, Christmas Eve.
sentences.zh: 玛丽琳在遇袭10天后的平安夜出院。

sentences.en: Police asked her if she could come with them and sit in different cars to see if she could recognise the one she was in.
sentences.zh: 警方问她是否愿意随他们去坐坐不同的车，看看能否认出她当时乘坐的那一辆。

sentences.en: She didn't recognise the exact car, but she was able to eliminate three off that list of eight.
sentences.zh: 她没能认出确切的车，但她从那八种车型中排除了三种。

sentences.en: A few months later, a senior lecturer in psychiatry at Leeds University was called in to perform hypnosis on both Marilyn and Maureen Long.
sentences.zh: 几个月后，利兹大学的一位精神病学高级讲师被请来对玛丽琳和莫琳·朗进行催眠。

sentences.en: Maureen also survived a ripper attack which we covered in part one.
sentences.zh: 莫琳也是“开膛手”袭击的幸存者，我们在第一部分中提到过。

sentences.en: They had several sessions of hypnosis.
sentences.zh: 她们进行了几次催眠疗程。

sentences.en: Maureen was never able to remember anything more however Marilyn did.
sentences.zh: 莫琳始终没能想起更多细节，但玛丽琳做到了。

sentences.en: She provided a second photo fit.
sentences.zh: 她提供了第二张模拟画像。

sentences.en: Most of the previous features were still there but this time she described the ripper as having longer hair.
sentences.zh: 大部分之前的特征依然存在，但这次她描述“开膛手”的头发更长。

sentences.en: marilyn also recalled seeing a cardboard box on the car's dashboard with the letters t r i the problem was that after these hypnosis sessions marilyn called the police numerous
sentences.zh: 玛丽琳还回忆起看到车仪表盘上有一个纸板箱，上面写着字母T R I。问题是，在这些催眠疗程之后，玛丽琳多次打电话给警方，

sentences.en: times to tell the officers that she'd seen her attacker the police actually arrested two men
sentences.zh: 告诉警官她看到了袭击者。警方实际上根据玛丽琳报告的

sentences.en: based on different sightings marilyn reported both bore similarities to the photo fit however they were eventually eliminated from the investigation george oldfield and jim hobson
sentences.zh: 不同目击情况逮捕了两名男子。两人都与模拟画像有相似之处，但最终都被排除在调查之外。乔治·奥尔德菲尔德和吉姆·霍布森

sentences.en: now started to doubt how good her memory and description of the Ripper was.
sentences.zh: 现在开始怀疑她对“开膛手”的记忆和描述到底有多准确。

sentences.en: Although no attack had happened in Huddersfield, which was 30 minutes away from Leeds,
sentences.zh: 尽管哈德斯菲尔德（距离利兹30分钟路程）没有发生过袭击事件，

sentences.en: Oldfield ordered officers to start a covert operation there to record registration numbers.
sentences.zh: 奥尔德菲尔德仍下令警官在那里展开秘密行动，记录车辆登记号码。

sentences.en: Oldfield had now put in place 33 different observation points.
sentences.zh: 奥尔德菲尔德当时已经设立了33个不同的观察点。

sentences.en: There were about 100 officers in total across all the points, working each night to record every registration plate they saw.
sentences.zh: 所有点位总共约有100名警官，每晚工作，记录他们看到的每一块车牌。

sentences.en: there were 14 points in chapeltown leeds 12 in manningham bradford and now seven in huddersfield
sentences.zh: 在利兹的查佩尔镇有14个点，布拉德福德的曼宁厄姆有12个，现在哈德斯菲尔德有7个，

sentences.en: 30 minutes south of leeds the officers would dictate the plates they saw onto a tape recorder
sentences.zh: 位于利兹以南30分钟路程。警官们会将看到的车牌口述录入录音机，

sentences.en: the tapes were then stored and kept for three months the idea being that if a murder happened
sentences.zh: 磁带随后会被保存三个月。其想法是，如果发生谋杀案，

sentences.en: they would go back to that night and go through all of the tapes to see what registrations were out and about.
sentences.zh: 他们可以回到那个晚上，翻阅所有的磁带，看看当时有哪些车辆在路上行驶。

sentences.en: It was common knowledge amongst the public this was going on and sex workers tried to use it to their advantage, telling clients that they were being clocked by the police
sentences.zh: 公众都知道这件事，性工作者甚至试图利用这一点，告诉客户她们正被警方监控，

sentences.en: and that they had better return them safely.
sentences.zh: 最好把她们安全送回。

sentences.en: Oldfield was a big believer in this operation.
sentences.zh: 奥尔德菲尔德非常相信这项行动。

sentences.en: However, it was in place in Chapel Town the night Marilyn was attacked.
sentences.zh: 然而，玛丽琳遇袭当晚，该行动就在查佩尔镇实施。

sentences.en: It didn't help prevent her attack and it didn't help catch who did it.
sentences.zh: 它既没能阻止她的遇袭，也没能帮助抓住凶手。

sentences.en: Helen Ripka had a Jamaican mother and a Polish father.
sentences.zh: 海伦·里普卡的母亲是牙买加人，父亲是波兰人。

sentences.en: She was a twin and her parents also had another set of twins, four kids in total, who were all eventually sent to foster homes.
sentences.zh: 她是双胞胎，她的父母还有另一对双胞胎，总共四个孩子，最终都被送进了寄养家庭。

sentences.en: The sets of twins were separated, however Helen remained with her twin sister Rita throughout the years.
sentences.zh: 这两对双胞胎被分开了，但海伦多年来一直和她的双胞胎姐妹丽塔在一起。

sentences.en: They lived in various different homes in that time.
sentences.zh: 在此期间，她们住在不同的寄养家庭里。

sentences.en: At the age of 18, Rita and Helen moved into a flat together in
sentences.zh: 18岁时，丽塔和海伦搬到一起，住在

sentences.en: Huddersfield.
sentences.zh: 哈德斯菲尔德的一间公寓里。

sentences.en: Rita had been attending art school but dropped out in her second year as she could no longer afford the fees.
sentences.zh: 丽塔曾就读于艺术学校，但因无力支付学费，在第二年退学了。

sentences.en: Helen had been working in a sweet factory in another town, but left her job behind to move in with Rita.
sentences.zh: 海伦曾在另一个城镇的糖果厂工作，但为了和丽塔住在一起，她辞去了工作。

sentences.en: Both started sex work around Huddersfield.
sentences.zh: 两人开始在哈德斯菲尔德附近从事性工作。

sentences.en: At 9pm on the 31st of
sentences.zh: 1978年1月31日晚上9点，

sentences.en: January 1978, Helen and Rita were working near a toilet block on Great Northern Street.
sentences.zh: 海伦和丽塔正在大北街的一个厕所附近工作。

sentences.en: It was a popular place for sex workers.
sentences.zh: 那是性工作者的热门地点。

sentences.en: Two limousines approached them and the drivers negotiated a price.
sentences.zh: 两辆豪华轿车靠近她们，司机谈好了价格。

sentences.en: Once they agreed, the drivers asked them to wait while they went to the toilet.
sentences.zh: 达成协议后，司机让她们等一下，他们要去上厕所。

sentences.en: When they got back, Rita entered one limousine and Helen entered the other.
sentences.zh: 当他们回来时，丽塔上了一辆豪华轿车，海伦上了另一辆。

sentences.en: At 9.25pm, Helen was dropped off back at the toilet block.
sentences.zh: 晚上9点25分，海伦被送回了厕所附近。

sentences.en: Five minutes later,
sentences.zh: 五分钟后，

sentences.en: Rita was dropped off, but she couldn't see Helen anywhere.
sentences.zh: 丽塔被送回，但她到处都找不到海伦。

sentences.en: Soon after, a man in a white sports car picked up Rita.
sentences.zh: 不久后，一名开着白色跑车的男子接走了丽塔。

sentences.en: Rita directed him back to her and Helen's flat in the hope that Helen had gone back there.
sentences.zh: 丽塔指引他回到她和海伦的公寓，希望海伦已经回去了。

sentences.en: But she wasn't.
sentences.zh: 但她不在。

sentences.en: Rita remained in the flat hoping
sentences.zh: 丽塔留在公寓里，希望

sentences.en: Helen would return, but she never did.
sentences.zh: 海伦能回来，但她再也没有回来。

sentences.en: Two days later, Rita decided to report Helen missing.
sentences.zh: 两天后，丽塔决定报告海伦失踪。

sentences.en: When she first made the report, Rita didn't tell the police their occupation or that they were on Great Northern Street.
sentences.zh: 当她第一次报案时，丽塔没有告诉警方她们的职业，也没有说她们当时在大北街。

sentences.en: But later that night, Rita ended up telling the police everything.
sentences.zh: 但那天晚上晚些时候，丽塔最终向警方坦白了一切。

sentences.en: And this completely changed the way the police handled the case.
sentences.zh: 这彻底改变了警方处理此案的方式。

sentences.en: Anna Rogulski was born in 1941 in Ireland.

sentences.en: Jeff had his own flat in Keeley's town centre.
sentences.zh: 杰夫在基利的市中心有自己的公寓。

sentences.en: At 2am Anna went to Jeff's flat and started banging on his door but he refused to open it.
sentences.zh: 凌晨 2 点，安娜来到杰夫的公寓开始猛敲他的门，但他拒绝开门。

sentences.en: Anna then took off one of her shoes and threw it at his window.
sentences.zh: 安娜随后脱下一只鞋，朝他的窗户扔去。

sentences.zh: 罗纳德·格雷戈里前往伦敦苏格兰场，会见了伦敦警察厅厅长。

sentences.zh: 那是奥德菲尔德刚接手调查时定下的方向。

sentences.zh: 苏格兰场建议精简整个文书处理流程。

sentences.zh: 他们说侦探需要专注于案件，而不是处理文书。
